note: 竖屏文戏编导提示词的原句库（从横屏原版改出来，2026-10-22）。每部戏的风格锁、画面质感、特效质感不在这里，在 竖屏制作/剧设定/<剧名>.md（规则 S1–S5）。这里只放所有戏通用的原句：texturePrefix 是画面质感的通用开头；required：必须一字不差的原句；status=verified 表示在验收通过的成片里用过（source 是哪一条，目前都来自打戏 v13），unverified 表示还没验证（文戏专用的句子都还没生成过）。第一条文戏验收通过后，用 make_canon.js 登记；改原句先问用户。 竖屏加了 V 开头的原句（TALL FRAME），都还没验证。
texturePrefix: 像一部用35mm胶片实拍的电影，不是CG动画

required.text: PRACTICAL EFFECTS ONLY. Every effect must look physically shot in camera on a film set on 35mm film, never added in post.

Real lens and real film: highlights bloom and halate with a red-orange halo, slight chromatic fringing, softer focus at the frame edges, heavy motion blur and step-printed smearing on fast action, film grain and faint scratches;
Nothing glows without lighting the world around it.
the light falling off into deep darkness
so that everything feels photographed in one real space
Restraint: a few large, motivated effects rather than many small ones. Every effect has a physical cause and a physical consequence.
